files.note: High oblique drone view from above the north end (the hill and 'The Zou' scoreboard) looking south into the empty bowl, August 2021, after the 2019 south end-zone facility. Field centred horizontally (x ~960-1500) and in rows ~575-910 of 1418 (41-64%). The frame is already close to 16:9; a crop of rows ~68-1418 puts the field at ~38-63%, so it sits just at the top-40% line, not above it. The north scoreboard carries a small 2021 COVID-19 vaccine message.
